policy.conditional_triggers: An event that must occur for a trigger to matter (e.g. 'after an ally attacks an enemy that dodged') is a valid Activates When tag; the builder must not treat it as wrong.
policy.vocab: The data carries the FULL taxonomy (every value that fits any object). The 'more than one object' rule is a DISPLAY toggle in the app (Hide single-object tags), never a build-time filter.
policy.ai_turn_actions: Actions chosen in bc_ArtificialIntelligence are normal turn actions, never Automatic/Extra.
policy.attack_requires_reference: Action/Mechanic::Attack only where the object references an attack (text or explicit dtype-0/attack code). Generic sourced damage = Damage only.
policy.related_stat_reads: Related Stat covers effects that READ a stat (highest-stat selection, multiplied by a stat). Action/Mechanic::Stats is carried by extension (superset rule).
policy.debuffed_gate: Activates When::Enemy is Debuffed doubles as the conditional gate 'enemy has a debuff'; never Ally is Debuffed for afflicter-side hooks.
policy.minions_not_buffs: Minions are Minions, not Buffs: minion conditions (CONDNAME_MINION_*) never produce Buff/Buff Count/Related Buff tags, and buffs never produce Minion tags.
policy.action_mechanic_superset: user 2026-10-04: Action/Mechanic values are catch-all pools of the narrower groupings; overlap is required. Any object with a narrower tag carries its Action/Mechanic parent (build-data implied pass).
policy.turns_vs_timeline: user 2026-10-06: turn references (extra turns, lost turns, turns taken / turn counter) belong to Action/Mechanic::Turn Counter, not Timeline. Timeline = position/order on the timeline. Start of battle is never a Timeline effect.
